issue_context.title: [BUG] Playwright for Android does not work with Android 13
issue_context.body:
Caused by the "Intent filters block non-matching intents"

See here: https://developer.android.com/about/versions/13/behavior-changes-13

This needs to be adjusted: https://github.com/mxschmitt/playwright/blob/1471c526addb1c66a4ae1a259ce045333940a90a/packages/playwright-core/src/server/android/android.ts#L253
